title: Desk Guidance Note — Inpatient Stays, Suspension and Breaks in Need for Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Inpatient Stays, Suspension and Breaks in Need — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Clauses

1. An inpatient or skilled nursing admission suspends the record with the admission date as the suspension date.
   > The words "with the admission date as the suspension date" are no longer in force for an inpatient or skilled nursing stay that is reported after it began and is recorded as a suspension of the active oxygen record. Every other stay remains under this clause and is suspended with its admission date as the suspension date; the suspension of the record on an admission remains in force.
2. No month whose first day falls during the suspension is billed.
3. Oxygen resumes in the same payment period only when the patient comes home no later than the class's break-in-need days after the suspension began, counting calendar days from the day after the suspension date, the allowance being the break-in-need days plus the days remaining in the month in which the suspension began.
4. > Clause retired in part: "A longer break starts a new payment period on the return-home date with the month count back at 1." This clause is no longer in force for a new payment period opened when a patient whose oxygen record is suspended chooses to keep the oxygen with Summit Ridge after a break in need that ran past the allowance. Every other new payment period after a longer break remains under this clause.
5. A new payment period after a longer break needs the class's new-period requirements before billing.
6. Travel is never a suspension.

## The break allowance as a time gate

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the suspension began |
| Record that shows it | the suspension date on the oxygen record (system record) |
| Counting | calendar days, from the day after the suspension date |
| Length of the allowance | the break-in-need days plus the days remaining in the month in which the suspension began |
| Comparison | the patient comes home no later than the last day of the allowance |
| Day equal to the last day of the allowance | inside the allowance |
| Result when met | oxygen resumes in the same payment period |

## Boundary cases (abstract)

- The patient comes home on the last day of the allowance: the gate is met and oxygen resumes in the same payment period.
- The patient comes home on the day after the last day of the allowance: the gate is not met; the break is a longer break, and a new payment period needs the class's new-period requirements before billing.

## Points of judgement

**Is a month billed while the record is suspended?** No month whose first day falls during the suspension is billed.

**Does a trip away from home suspend the Home Oxygen Therapy record?** No; travel is never a suspension.
